part.name: Mounting bracket with arched web and threaded top boss
part.description: Single-piece bracket: wide base mounting flange with two through-holes; a vertical/arched load path with a large internal clearance cutout; two opposed obround side pockets; an upper rectangular housing block with a small cross-drilled hole; and a top cylindrical boss with a vertical threaded/bored interface and blended seat.
part.symmetry_note: Upper/mid body is largely symmetric about the mid-thickness plane z≈-21 (opposed side pockets and similar side blends). The base flange is wider (z to -60) than the main body (z to -42), so overall symmetry is partial.

Section.name: Base mounting flange
features included: flat mounting datum faces (top/bottom of flange)
Section.function intent: Provide a stable mounting interface to a supporting structure and distribute reaction loads into the bracket.
Section.physical behavior: Works primarily in compression at the mounting interface and bending/shear through the flange thickness; corner rounds reduce stress concentration; through-holes accept fasteners to clamp the flange to a mating surface.
Section.geometry: Wide rectangular plate (y=0..15) wider in z than the upper body, with rounded outside corners and two vertical through-holes near the ends.
Section.location: Lowest portion of the part (y=0..15), spanning full length in x and full flange width in z (z=-60..0).

Section.name: Lower arched web + clearance cutout + opposed obround pockets
features included: arched load path / arm (outer convex curve)
opposed obround blind pockets (one from each side face)
outer vertical side walls and blends to base
local corner/edge fillets around lower transitions
Section.function intent: Transmit loads from the upper housing/boss down to the base while providing clearance for a mating component via the large internal cutout and side pockets.
Section.physical behavior: Carries combined bending and shear; arched outer surface increases section modulus; internal cutout reduces mass while maintaining a rib-like load path; blends/fillets reduce peak stress at curvature changes; pockets reduce mass/provide clearance without breaking through the web.
Section.geometry: Main body thickness z=-42..0 above the flange; includes a large curved internal window defined by cylindrical arcs plus planar/angled transitions; includes two obround blind pockets (one from z=0 side to z=-10, and one from z=-42 side to z=-32).
Section.location: Between the base flange and upper block, primarily y=15..~156; spans x approximately 28.5..134.5 within the main body thickness (z=-42..0).

Section.name: Upper housing block + top seat pocket + cross-hole
Section.function intent: Provide a stiff mounting/housing region for the top boss interface, including a transverse pin/fastener/vent feature (cross-hole) and a seated platform for the boss.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a compression/tension and bending node: spreads load from the boss into the web; the seat/shoulder provides bearing area and locates the boss; cross-hole provides secondary interface with minimal effect on global stiffness due to its small diameter relative to block section.
Section.geometry: Rectangular prismatic block region with a stepped/seat platform (y=153 and y=162 planes), local blends/fillets, and a small cylindrical cross-hole (R=3) through the block.
Section.location: Upper portion of the main body beneath the boss, roughly y≈84..162 around x≈46.5..88.5 and z=-42..0.

Section.name: Top boss + threaded/bored interface
Section.function intent: Provide the primary functional interface for a mating fastener/shaft/fitting via a vertical threaded/bored hole and a locating boss.
Section.physical behavior: Carries local bearing/contact loads at the boss seat and internal thread/bore; blends reduce notch sensitivity where high axial and bending stresses concentrate at the boss root.
Section.geometry: Outer cylinder (R=12) rising above the seat; internal vertical cylinder (R≈7.0175) for bore/thread; top planar cap and conical entry chamfer; toroidal/BSpline blends at the boss root/seat region.
Section.location: Topmost feature (y≈162..180) centered at x≈67.5, within main body thickness (z around -21).
